newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: HEINEKEN'S MURPHY POSTS RECORD '96 SALES.
newsitem.headline: HEINEKEN'S MURPHY POSTS RECORD '96 SALES.

text.p: Murphy Brewery Ireland said on Thursday that sales increased by 12.4 percent in 1996 to a record 140 million Irish pounds.

The Heineken-owned brewery said in a statement that overall volume grew by 12.3 percent to 938,000 hectolitres, increasing the company's share of the total Irish beer market to 16.3 percent from 15.4 percent in 1995.

"This continued strong performance was driven primarily by the introduction of innovative marketing strategies which resulted in the strongest ever performance for the company's key brands, Heineken Lager and Murphy's Irish stout," it said.
Heineken captured a 39 percent share of the draught lager market in Ireland last year while Murphy's Irish stout recorded an 11 percent increase in sales, the company said.
The stout is now available in 63 countries world-wide and export sales of the brand grew by 198 percent last year.
The brewery said it was confident of achieving similar levels of growth for its brands this year through continued investment in marketing, manufacturing capacity and distribution.
